about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I’m Hasan Malik, a software engineer and AI enthusiast. I build intelligent, data-driven applications with a focus on elegant design and real-world impact.

timeline.event: Joined TachonTech as a software engineer

projects.title: Lenzeit
projects.description: AI-powered media delivery system for photography studios

projects.title: CropX
projects.description: Developed a full-stack precision agriculture system that integrates Arduino-based IoT sensors to capture real-time soil chemistry (NPK), moisture, and ambient weather. Engineered a Python-powered ML pipeline that processes live data streams to provide farmers with predictive crop health insights and automated irrigation decision-making via a React web interface.

projects.title: Fraud Detection System
projects.description: Built a robust anomaly detection engine using the XGBoost algorithm to identify fraudulent transactions in real-time. Designed a custom Flask Admin Dashboard for security analysts to monitor model confidence scores, manage alert logs, and fine-tune detection parameters without touching the underlying code.

projects.title: US Financial Waste Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Combining Bulk Government provided APIs to create a comprehensive dashboard for tracking and analyzing financial waste in the United States.

projects.title: Grade Mate
projects.description: Computer vision-based student Quiz marking and performance analytics Application

projects.title: Kai-Cure
projects.description: A doctor assistant application that utilizes LLMs to record Doctor-Patient interactions and Geneate SOAP notes.

projects.title: PULSE AI
projects.description: A high-performance Big Data Analytics platform that leverages Machine Learning to ingest complex corporate datasets. The system identifies hidden patterns and market anomalies, delivering predictive forecasts that allow stakeholders to transition from reactive to data-driven proactive decision-making.

projects.title: Chat Bot
projects.description: A react Based Chat Bot that utilizes OpenAI's API to provide intelligent responses and engage in natural language conversations with users.

experience.details: Launched Lenzeit, an AI-powered bulk photo delivery platform revolutionizing media distribution.
Engineered innovative AI solutions at Amal-Axis, focusing on LLM integration and neural architectures.
Developed scalable applications at TechyonTech, optimizing backend performance and user experience.
Delivered high-quality software solutions for a diverse range of international clients.
